description: Score a text, email, chat or voicemail transcript against Aya's scam rules (urgency, hard-to-reverse payments, credential and code requests, government or tech-support impersonation, prizes, family emergencies, deposits to unlock earnings, disguised links) in English or Spanish. Returns the risk level and score, the reasons, what to do now and what to do if the person already acted. Runs locally; the message is not stored or sent anywhere.

message.description: The message text as received (links may be written as hxxp or with [.]).

repeatedContact.description: True when the sender has contacted the person repeatedly.

unknownSender.description: True when the sender is not a saved contact.

name: scam_check
title: Screen a message for scam patterns
